name: Hardened Foes
description: Enemy ships take {value}% less damage to shields, armor and hull.
flavor: Someone has been selling the good plating to the wrong people.

name: Deadly Foes
flavor: Every raider in the Sector seems to have found a better gunnery manual.

name: Thin Insulation
description: Your ships and your allies' ships stay overloaded {value}% longer.

name: Hungry Fleet
description: Your ships use {value}% more supplies each month.
flavor: Spare parts vanish, and nobody saw a thing.

name: Harsh Worlds
description: Your colonies have {value}% more hazard rating.
flavor: The worlds remember the Domain's mistakes, and they make settlers pay for them.

name: Veteran Crews
description: Your ships have {value}% more maximum combat readiness.
flavor: Old hands who have seen worse than this.

name: Lean Logistics
description: Your ships use {value}% fewer supplies each month.
flavor: A quartermaster who counts every bolt twice.

name: Hyperspace Drifter
description: Your ships gain {value} maximum burn level.
flavor: Ride the currents, never against them.

name: Ludd's Song
flavor: The gates sing for those who woke them.
unlockHint: Finish At the Gates to unlock.

name: Peerless
description: Grants {value} Peerless point, once per campaign.
flavor: Some captains are simply better than the rest.
